_about: Who lives where, and what they say. 'show' maps a level to a condition; 'talk' is checked top to bottom and the first entry whose 'when' holds is used. Conditions are flag names joined by '&', with '!' for not. Flags: met_<id> (set by talking), w1_clear, w2_clear. 'set' flags are set when the conversation ends. 'shop' opens the shop after the lines.

lines: OH. YOU'RE AWAKE. GOOD.
THIS IS LAST RELAY. THE LAST STATION ON THE LINE THAT STILL HUMS.
SOMETHING OUT THERE KEEPS CALLING. THREE RINGS, THEN A VOICE WE CAN'T MAKE OUT.
IT COMES FROM PAST THE GATES. NONE OF US CAN GET THAT FAR.
YOU'RE A SPARK, THOUGH. YOU CAN. FOLLOW THE LINE AND BRING BACK WHAT YOU HEAR.
THE RELAY'S QUIET. FIRST TIME IN YEARS.
LISTEN. THE CALL HAS A SHAPE NOW. WREN WILL WANT TO TELL YOU.
YOU LIT THE FIRST GATE. THE CALL WAS LOUDER LAST NIGHT.
IT'S FURTHER DOWN THE LINE NOW. PAST THE SWITCHYARD.
THE LINE STARTS AT THE SIGNPOST, EAST OF HERE.
TALLY WILL TRADE FOR ANY SHARDS YOU BRING BACK.
SHARDS! PROPER SIGNAL, THOSE. HARD TO COME BY.
I'LL TRADE YOU PARTS FOR THEM. HAVE A LOOK.
WHAT'LL IT BE?
OH! A SPARK!
I FOLLOWED THE CALL OUT HERE, AND THE FLOOR KEPT FALLING AWAY UNDER ME.
I'VE BEEN WRITING DOWN WHAT IT SAYS. IT ISN'T STATIC. IT'S WORDS.
I'M GOING BACK TO LAST RELAY. FIND ME IN THE RADIO SHACK.
I HEARD IT CLEARLY THIS TIME.
IT SAYS: SPARK. COME HOME.
WHERE IS HOME, FOR SOMETHING LIKE YOU?
SINCE YOU LIT THE GATE I CAN HEAR MORE OF IT.
IT'S A NAME. OR HALF OF ONE. IT KEEPS BREAKING OFF.
I'M STILL WORKING ON THE CALL. IT'S HALF A WORD, OVER AND OVER.
LIGHT THE GATE AND MAYBE I'LL HEAR THE REST.
CAREFUL IN HERE. THE OLD CREWS CUT THESE LINES ON PURPOSE.
NOT TO HURT ANYONE. TO STOP THE NOISE SPREADING FROM ONE STATION TO THE NEXT.
SEE THIS HANDLE ON MY BELT? THAT'S HOW YOU ISOLATE A LINE. ONE FAULT DOESN'T TAKE EVERYTHING.
GET THROUGH THE GATE. I'LL SEE YOU AT LAST RELAY.
YOU BLEW THE RELAY'S FUSES? GOOD.
A MACHINE THAT CAN'T STOP PROTECTING ITSELF ISN'T PROTECTING ANYONE.
THE SWITCHYARD SPLITS THE LINE IN TWO. ONE CHANNEL LIVE, ONE DEAD.
THAT'S HOW THEY KEPT THE NOISE OUT. IT WORKED. MOSTLY.
BLINK. BLINK. OH, HELLO.
ONE CHANNEL OR THE OTHER. NEVER BOTH. HIT A SWITCH AND THE WORLD CHANGES SHAPE.
I RAN THE SWITCHBOARD AT LAST RELAY, ONCE. MAYBE I'LL GO BACK AND RUN IT AGAIN.
THE SWITCHBOARD OUTSIDE IS LIVE AGAIN.
PICK ANY LINE YOU'VE WALKED BEFORE. I'LL PATCH YOU THROUGH.
THAT RELAY AHEAD HASN'T STOPPED SWAPPING SINCE THE FAILURE.
IT'S TRYING TO KEEP THE NOISE OUT, AND IT'S SHAKING ITSELF APART DOING IT.
BLOW ITS THREE FUSES. IT'LL REST. SO WILL I.
FIRST QUIET NIGHT IN YEARS.
THANK YOU, LITTLE SPARK.
